item.title: Student Memorial, Teachers Union Deal, Plane Crash
item.ns0:title: Student Memorial, Teachers Union Deal, Plane Crash
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, an emotional school community gathers to honor the memory of a sixteen-year-old student tragically killed in a lightning strike. Months of tense negotiations come to an end as the government and the teachers' union reach a landmark five-year industrial agreement to avert nationwide strike action. Search teams make a solemn discovery following a fatal small plane crash off North Andros, while Junkanoo groups receive a major financial boost as over $700,000 in seed funding kicks off the new parade season. Tune in for these top stories, critical updates for local workers, and your complete sports and weather forecast.
